user_request: Preserve existing official final; additional research authorized; user alone decides adoption.
purpose: Frozen32-feature BC plus transparent post-neural progress/resource safeguards, no retraining.
inputs: 4 arrival/load families x 2 previously calibrated mix-reference capacities x 4 new request/arrival/latent seeds. N1024, classification urgent0.8s/detection normal2s only. Exact mix totals shuffled. Poisson first arrival35 then independent exponential gaps, no rescaling; empirical rate reported. Same observed initial context. Nominal capacity inherited as reference, not measured actual saturation.
selection: One frozen BC and adopted frozen PPO881087, physical mask then argmax, temperature0.35, same32/27 ABI. No retraining, search, fallback or deadline shield.
BC_lineage: BC_COMMON_FINAL includes earlier PPO ancestry; BC means frozen immediately before the last PPO stage, not a PPO-free training lineage.
ablations: BC_NO_ROLLING skips future rollout/publicWork/horizon extension and zeros features21..29, retaining measured-state power18 and instantaneous timing9,10. BC_NO_ATC zeros feature11, skips ATC scoring and uses EDF/FIFO/route fill for candidate selection. Both retain original8 candidates and causal route preference. Frozen runtime/input intervention, not retrained architecture; distribution shift limits interpretation.
service_first: Fixed lexicographic minimize [predicted urgent lateness cost2, unfinished cost4, normal lateness cost3, cost0/0.6215900945595554+cost1/0.42450663682233236], each rounded to1e-12; then max ATC11, ordinal, index. Uses only public nominal predictions. No parameter tuning or hard action mask.
decision_rule: Meaningful candidate improvement requires >=1pp overall on-time gain with urgent loss<=0.1pp, no more unfinished; OR >=1% paired mean API-J reduction with both urgent and overall on-time within0.1pp and no more unfinished. Report all families/cases/worst-case, P95 and failures. Passing is conditional model evidence, not adoption or real-device proof. No significance claim from requests as independent samples.
order: Fixed case order; rotate10 method order by case index. One attempt per identity, preserve every failure; no replacement seed or completed rerun.
offline: Existing8 BC banks: exact saved argmax reproducibility and masking21..29/11/both/31 sensitivity, no plant. Mechanism diagnosis on prior cohort, not new validation.
preflight: No plant: exact full-mode bank/action compatibility versus original FAIR policy on saved public/crowded fixtures; ablation feature/guard tests and deterministic selector fixtures. Pin sources, checkpoints, input before new plant.
common: No original physical engine/coefficients/deadlines/observation window/model/NN weights changed; no new learning/device measurement/fit. Separate method identities for old inputs; completed original methods never rerun. No parameter search, retry, seed replacement, refund, reservation/automation query or resume.
physical_gate: FAIL remains: API-J/AP only; CPU3 extra-core, interference and mobile NN/planner costs unmeasured; fixed measured template pools and shared initial context constrain generality.
authorization: User explicitly requests reducing urgent deadline failures/unfinished while retaining rolling+ATC+BC energy/heat savings; preserve existing official policy.

guards.BC_DISPATCH_ONLY: Choose maximum unchanged BC logit among physical DISPATCH actions, prohibit voluntary WAIT only.
guards.BC_PROGRESS_GUARD: Dispatch-only plus earliest urgent nominal response+one occupancy deadline-risk protection; if risky prefer nominal-on-time routes, else fastest. If not urgent-risk and oldest normal already late, dispatch that oldest normal.
guards.BC_RESOURCE_GUARD: Progress guard plus CPU inference slot reserved for detection and NPU-first classification; GPU allowed only when NPU occupied and visible NPU-only EDF prefix projects a missed deadline. Same nominal predictor and zero extra margin. Owner charged one full nominal occupancy, no hidden remaining progress.

architecture: Original frozen BC network,32 features/27 original physical-mask logits unchanged. A separate explicit guard selects the greatest original logit among its admissible original actions. Empty resource envelope returns NONE before rollout/NN. Not pure BC, not PPO, and no learned improvement claim.
selection_rule: Before any confirm8 execution, choose one fixed guard using development32+original4 only. Eligible: all original4 urgent100%/unfinished0, original4 on-time no worse than BC by0.1pp, mean J <=1.01*BC and AP<=BC+0.1C; development nominal85 unfinished0, urgent>=99.9%, J<=1.01*BC and AP<=BC+0.1C. If any eligible, minimize development stress urgent misses, then nominal85 J, then method order. Otherwise choose lexicographically [original4 urgent misses+unfinished,nominal85 unfinished,nominal85 urgent misses,nominal85 J] and mark target unmet. Confirm8 cannot change this selection.
reporting: Separate original4/development32/confirm8 and85/105 subgroups; all methods/cases/failures. Raw BC energy includes missing work, so do not call its difference equal-service savings. Compare service-qualified savings against same-input completed EDF; report both NPU/GPU reference where available, retained gap and extra completed work. Max normal latency included.
confirmation: 8 new synthetic inputs, one per family/mix, generated before all new evaluations. Limited repetition and same measured pools/model/initial context; not independent device confirmation. All3 guards disclosed even if selected guard fails.
cache: Retain existing cached original features to isolate service-guard contribution. Known cache-equivalence FAIL is preserved; this study does not fix/calibrate predictor.
